title: Social Media Privacy Risk Calculator - Check Your Exposure
metaDescription: Calculate your social media privacy risk across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and X. Get personalized recommendations to protect your data.
description: Assess your privacy exposure across major social media platforms. This calculator evaluates your settings, sharing habits, and data permissions to provide a comprehensive privacy risk score with actionable improvement suggestions.

inputs.label: Number of Social Media Platforms You Use
inputs.helpText: Count Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, Snapchat, etc.

options.label: Public - Anyone can see my posts

inputs.label: Personal Information You Share
inputs.helpText: Count: real name, phone, email, location, workplace, relationship status, photos with family, etc.

inputs.label: Connected Third-Party Apps/Games
inputs.helpText: Apps that connect to your social media accounts for login or data access

inputs.label: Ad Personalization Enabled
inputs.helpText: Whether you allow platforms to use your data for targeted advertising

inputs.label: Have you downloaded your data from platforms?

outputFields.label: Privacy Risk Score
outputFields.description: Your overall privacy risk level (0-100, higher = more risk)

outputFields.label: Data Exposure Rating
outputFields.description: Estimated percentage of personal data potentially exposed

formula: const platformWeight = Math.min(inputs.platformsUsed * 5, 25); const visibilityRisk = inputs.profileVisibility === 'public' ? 20 : inputs.profileVisibility === 'mixed' ? 15 : inputs.profileVisibility === 'friends' ? 8 : 3; const personalInfoRisk = Math.min(inputs.personalInfoShared * 3, 20); const locationRisk = inputs.locationSharing === 'always' ? 15 : inputs.locationSharing === 'sometimes' ? 10 : inputs.locationSharing === 'rare' ? 5 : 0; const appsRisk = Math.min(inputs.thirdPartyApps * 1.5, 15); const adRisk = inputs.adPersonalization ? 8 : 2; const downloadBonus = inputs.dataDownloadCheck === 'regularly' ? -5 : inputs.dataDownloadCheck === 'once' ? -2 : 0; const settingsBonus = inputs.privacySettings === 'regularly' ? -10 : inputs.privacySettings === 'sometimes' ? -5 : inputs.privacySettings === 'rarely' ? -2 : 0; const rawScore = platformWeight + visibilityRisk + personalInfoRisk + locationRisk + appsRisk + adRisk + downloadBonus + settingsBonus; const riskScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, rawScore)); const riskLevel = riskScore >= 70 ? 'High Risk' : riskScore >= 40 ? 'Medium Risk' : riskScore >= 20 ? 'Low Risk' : 'Very Low Risk'; const dataExposure = Math.min(95, Math.max(5, riskScore * 0.8 + (inputs.personalInfoShared * 2))); return { riskScore: Math.round(riskScore), riskLevel, dataExposure: Math.round(dataExposure) };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates your social media privacy risk based on platform usage, privacy settings, data sharing habits, and security practices. The scoring considers the cumulative effect of multiple platforms, visibility settings, personal information exposure, location sharing, third-party app permissions, and advertising personalization. Regular privacy audits and restrictive settings significantly reduce your risk score.
tips: Review and tighten privacy settings on all platforms at least quarterly
Limit personal information in profiles - avoid phone numbers, addresses, and workplace details
Disable location sharing and remove location data from past posts
Regularly audit and remove unused third-party apps and games
Turn off ad personalization to reduce data collection for marketing
Use Incognito Browser when accessing social media to prevent additional tracking
Download your data from platforms annually to see what information they have
Enable two-factor authentication on all social media accounts
Be selective about friend/follower requests from unknown people
Consider using different email addresses for social media accounts

interpretation.label: Very Low Risk
interpretation.description: Excellent privacy practices. Your social media presence has minimal privacy exposure.

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good privacy awareness with minor areas for improvement. Most data is well-protected.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Moderate privacy exposure. Several settings need attention to better protect your data.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant privacy exposure across multiple areas. Immediate action needed to secure your data.
